concept.title: User Devices
concept.shortdesc: User devices are the endpoints that use network resources and Internet services. They connect to the home network through wired or wireless connections.

section.title: Overview
section.p: A user device is any device that connects to a network to access resources, services, or Internet connectivity.
User devices communicate with other devices on the network through the .

section.title: Types of User Devices
section.p: A home network can support many types of user devices.

section.title: How User Devices Connect to the Network
section.p: User devices can connect to the home network through wired or wireless connections.
Wired devices connect to an available on the .
Wireless devices connect to the Wi Fi network identified by the SSID .

section.title: Role of User Devices
section.p: User devices use network resources and Internet services to perform various tasks.
Depending on the device type, users can browse websites, stream media, print documents, access cloud services, or control smart home devices.

section.title: User Devices in a Home Network
section.p: The acts as the central connection point for user devices on the home network.
